name: Canyonlands National Park
policyReason: Pets are banned from trails, overlooks and the backcountry; only paved roads, campgrounds and the Potash/Shafer drive.
summary: Pets are banned from trails, overlooks and the backcountry; only paved roads, campgrounds and the Potash/Shafer drive.

excerpts.quote: Pets must be leashed at all times.
Pets are prohibited in any backcountry area, including within vehicles on designated backcountry roads, on any hiking trails, at any overlook

dogRules.text: No pets in the backcountry, on trails, at overlooks or on river trips.
Pets may ride through on the Shafer Trail to Potash Road.
Do not leave a pet tied to an object other than your own vehicle.
